data.name: ConflictCommand
data.comment: {0} is a key combination, {1} the command using it, {2} that command's category.

data.name: ConflictNeedsModifier
data.value: A shortcut needs Ctrl or Alt, unless it is a function key. Shift can join them but cannot hold a shortcut on its own.

data.name: ConflictReserved
data.value: {0} is reserved for "{1}" and cannot be assigned.
data.comment: {0} is a key combination, {1} the built-in action it belongs to.

data.name: ConflictSystemReserved
data.value: {0} is reserved by Windows and cannot be assigned.
data.comment: {0} is a key combination such as Ctrl+Alt+Delete.

data.name: NotAShortcut
data.comment: {0} is the text that was read.
